nodes.text: ICMR has detected 2 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka. Both cases don't have any Foreign Travel History & are identified through routine surveillance for multiple respiratory viral pathogens.Let's not spread panic & wait for Central Govt's response.
